# Numbered mission pillars

Release requested by Justin Horton on October 21, 2026.

Give the three commitments under “What we commit to” a distinct editorial
treatment. Large gold numerals and fine green rules separate the pillars on
desktop; a compact number-and-copy layout creates clearer rhythm on phones.
The vision, mission, pillar wording and supporting commitments stay the same.

Validation: Astro production build, generated Mission page check for all three
numbered commitments, and Wix hosted preview before release. The existing
deployment workflow builds the protected account runtime and verifies live
routes after publication.
